name: Bay Area ADA Paratransit
description: Door-to-door transit for people with disabilities who cannot use regular buses/trains
fullDescription: ADA Paratransit is a shared-ride, door-to-door transportation service for people who cannot use regular public transit due to a disability. Bay Area transit agencies provide coordinated paratransit service with regional certification—eligibility with one operator grants access to all Bay Area paratransit programs.
whatTheyOffer:
- Door-to-door or curb-to-curb pickup and drop-off service
- Shared rides via small buses, vans, taxis, or sedans (usually reserved at least one day ahead)
- Service available in the same areas and during the same hours as regular fixed-route transit
- Regional certification accepted by all Bay Area operators
- Personal care attendants ride free
howToGetIt:
1. Contact your local transit agency to request an application (dial 511 for a free transfer)
2. Complete the ADA paratransit eligibility application
3. You may need a phone interview or in-person assessment; decisions are due within 21 days
4. Once certified, you can use paratransit across the Bay Area
5. Call 511 and say "paratransit" then your city name for local info
keywords: paratransit, ADA, accessible transit, disability transportation, door to door, wheelchair accessible, 511
